summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) wave-by-wave, hardening the IPNS verification stack across Rust and TypeScript layers to be strictly fail-closed and removing all legacy degraded-acceptance paths.
summary.outcome: Waves 1 and most of Wave 2 completed: plans 60-01 through 60-04 done (4/8), with Wave 2 continuing into 60-05 at transcript end. All cross-plan build/test gates passed (251/251 sdk-core tests green).

repo: Phase 60 has 8 plans across 4 waves; Wave 4 (60-08) is non-autonomous (operational cutover: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) and requires human action.
The gsd-executor subagent commits `cargo check` clean but sometimes leaves uncommitted artifacts (Cargo.lock updates, stray SUMMARY footer edits) that need manual cleanup between plans.

60-01 folded all 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms as a compile necessity, overlapping with 60-04's declared scope — wave boundary between plan scopes can blur when compile errors force broader edits.
crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was a re-export shim; after 60-01 moved the impl to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs, 60-04 deleted the now-empty file.
60-02 seq=1 unification had a downstream effect on vault.test.ts (expected 0n → 1n), which 60-03's executor caught and fixed rather than failing.
Windows winfsp site is CI-gated and cannot be locally verified; expected gap in local validation for desktop Tauri paths.

code.finding: Was the last VerifyError::Legacy reference; executor folded it to Invalid. A mid-edit compile snapshot made it look like a remaining error but grep confirmed zero Legacy refs post-60-01.
Deleted by 60-04 after 60-01 moved the implementation to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs. Was only a re-export shim.

workflow: The gsd-commit helper reports 'commit_failed / No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands successfully — a known false-negative; always verify with git log rather than trusting the helper response.

Sequential gsd-executor subagents on the feature branch (rather than worktree isolation) was chosen for a strict fail-closed crypto-cutover phase because worktree branch manifests aren't reliably accessible for merge-back.

Cargo.lock must be committed alongside Cargo.toml dep additions; executors adding new crate deps (e.g. ciborium for CBOR Validity parsing) don't always auto-commit the lockfile, which creates a latent --locked CI break.
Stray artifacts left by one executor (SUMMARY footer, Cargo.lock) should be audited and cleaned before the next plan starts to avoid polluting subsequent executor context.
Wave 1 post-merge gate (cargo check -p cipherbox-fuse + sdk-core tests) is the right cross-plan integration check for changes spanning fuse/metadata.rs and sdk-core ipns paths.

friction: gsd-commit helper false-negative ('commit_failed') required manual git log verification after every commit — caused uncertainty about whether changes landed.
60-01 executor's mid-edit compile error snapshot (metadata.rs:619 VerifyError::Legacy) was stale and misleading; required a manual grep + cargo check to confirm the build was actually clean.
60-01 executor left Cargo.lock uncommitted after adding ciborium + cipherbox-core deps to api-client, creating a latent --locked CI break that had to be caught and committed manually between plans.

60-01 executor appended a stray footer to 60-01-SUMMARY.md after its own commit, leaving the file dirty with factually wrong content (said 'verify.rs FOUND' but 60-04 later deleted it); had to be reverted manually.
Worktree isolation mode couldn't be used because worktree path/branch manifests aren't exposed to the orchestrator, forcing sequential execution and higher wall-clock time.
